name: Skill_Seekers
tagline_zh: 把文档、GitHub、PDF 一键炼成 Claude 技能，自动查重防冲突。别处没有的：连依赖关系都帮你理清。
tagline_en: Turn docs, GitHub, PDFs into Claude skills with auto conflict detection—plus dependency mapping no one else offers.
desc_en: Convert documentation websites, GitHub repositories, and PDFs into Claude AI skills with automatic conflict detection
why_zh: 同类工具只做转换，它却内置冲突检测和依赖梳理，让你从源头避开技能打架。
why_en: Unlike converters, it detects conflicts and maps dependencies, preventing skill clashes at the source.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
